title: Module 1 Quiz
description: Test your understanding of output, comments, strings, and sequential execution across all lessons in Module 1.

questions.prompt_text: What is the main purpose of Module 1: Introduction to Python and Output?
options_json: To display clear text output and arrange simple Python statements in the correct order
To replace Python with another language
To remove the need for practice
questions.explanation: This module focuses on how to display clear text output and arrange simple Python statements in the correct order.
